questionEn: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Changes in the state of aggregation of substances”?
questionUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri “Moddalarning yig‘ilish holatining o‘zgarishi” bandidagi materialga mos keladi?
choicesEn: Does not have a specific volume or shape; occupies the entire volume of the vessel
choicesUz: Muayyan hajm yoki shaklga ega emas; idishning butun hajmini egallaydi
explanationEn: Gas does not have a constant volume and shape.
explanationUz: Gaz doimiy hajm va shaklga ega emas.
